Sidecar configuration for the opencode-quota-extended plugin. Drop this file at ~/.config/opencode/opencode-quota-extended.json (or point $OPENCODE_QUOTA_EXTENDED_CONFIG at a custom path) to override the built-in defaults. Any field can be omitted to fall back to its default. Keys starting with '_' (like this _comment) are documentation and are ignored by the loader. Fields:
  enabled (boolean): master switch for the plugin.
  enabledProviders (string[]): provider ids to fetch; at least one required. Allowed: 'openai', 'github-copilot', 'opencode-go'.
  refreshIntervalMs (number, int > 0): how often to re-fetch quota data, in ms.
  requestTimeoutMs (number, int > 0): HTTP timeout for the OpenAI / Copilot fetchers, in ms.
  opencodeGoTimeoutMs (number, int > 0): HTTP timeout for the OpenCode Go scraper, in ms.
  showOnlyMultiWindow (boolean): when true, providers with a single window render as a compact line instead of a card.
  cardsSidebar (object): sidebar panel settings.
    enabled (boolean): render the sidebar panel.
    order (number, 0..100000): render order in the sidebar; values < 150 sit below the official Quota panel.
  opencodeGoWindows (string[]): OpenCode Go windows to display. Allowed: '5h' (rolling 5h), 'weekly', 'monthly'; at least one required.
